exposure: Robson classification groups (based on parity, cesarean delivery in medical history, labor onset, number of fetuses, gestational age, and fetal presentation)
outcome: contribution of Robson classification groups to overall cesarean delivery rates
cohort: The study included 13,882 women who gave birth in 2017, 2019, and 2022 at the Municipal Clinical Hospital in Chisinau.
finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate was 20.02% and increased significantly, with women with a previous cesarean delivery (Robson group 5) being the main contributor to the overall rate.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate was 20.02% and significantly increased between study years, with women having a previous cesarean delivery (Robson group 5) being the main contributor.
